text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin reflects on the many ways<n>she differs
from her friends—from<n>their upbringings, attitudes
toward life,<n>and running styles, down to their
reasons for running and why others<n>support them.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She tells me she runs because that's<n>what she
wants to do, and I tell her<n>that's reason enough.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't want her to focus on what<n>people want from
her—I just want to<n>see her racing eagerly, happily,
and<n>freely.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My plain and simple encouragement<n>gets through
to her. I know well that<n>my support will help her.
It's time for<n>us to enjoy the autumn Tenno Sho to
the fullest!
